fit.scope: frozen fit-only label-blind diagnostic; query/WSI/patient moments separately named; ratio undefined cases omitted with explicit counts
fit.constant_delta_scope: original update evaluated with its weighted row mean only; recorded numerical residual, never relabeled literal zero
fit.centered_delta_scope: subtract selected a0*gate-weighted row mean without clipping; test invariance of original update
fit.Taylor_scope: rho*a0*gate*(delta-weighted_mean); first-order approximation, not assumed exact

heldout.scope: frozen heldout label-blind diagnostic; original fitted weights and preprocessing fixed; shallow partition view only, no fitting, epoch selection or endpoint access; query/WSI/patient moments separately named; undefined ratios omitted with explicit counts
heldout.constant_delta_scope: original update evaluated with its weighted row mean only; recorded numerical residual, never relabeled literal zero
heldout.centered_delta_scope: subtract selected a0*gate-weighted row mean without clipping; test invariance of original update
heldout.Taylor_scope: rho*a0*gate*(delta-weighted_mean); first-order approximation, not assumed exact
